document: ET-8b — THE ARTEFACT TABLE. Every arm, every seed, every interval, every instrument hash, one file. 理 11853.
the_sentence_this_table_supports: The frontier moved twice and stopped. A second generation improves on the first on both independent 300s at no extra cost; a third does not improve on the second, and on one seed is significantly worse. The best head is generation 1.
how_to_read_it: Seed by seed, never pooled. Two independent 300s (v3c/seed 73 on llm1, v3rep/seed 47 on llm2), disjoint from the heads' training set by MEASURED signature overlap of zero.

the_rise__gen1_vs_gen0.cost: model tokens +0.1% and -3.0%; controller cost identical by construction
the_rise__gen1_vs_gen0.reading: §4 row 1 — ACCUMULATION, the frontier moved twice

the_stop__gen2_vs_gen1.reading: 理 11853: BOTH §7 rows reported as they fired — PLATEAU on seed 73, CONSUMPTION on seed 47. The seeds do NOT disagree in direction (both negative; intervals overlap on [-6.3,-3.0]).

4_INSTRUMENT_BY_HASH.rule: 理 11768 §3 — a result artefact names its instrument by hash or its downstream claims are marked unauditable
4_INSTRUMENT_BY_HASH.⚠️_gen2_d1_and_d2_are_byte_identical_to_: BY CONSTRUCTION, not by accident: decision 1's state depends only on the task, so every generation fits the same d1 head, and d2 follows from d1. Only d3 differs. These hashes are what would catch a future change breaking that.

task_set_signatures_sha256_16.method: sha256 over each task's program|symptom|bug_region, files sorted

5_WHAT_WAS_WITHDRAWN_AND_WHY: gen0's +35.0 on all 300 — the head was fitted on tasks <226 and the loop ran all 300. Held out: +17.3.

gen1's FIRST run (-12.0 vs gen0) — its heads were fitted on gen0's contaminated episodes, where the true region is already found at decision 1 in 128 of 128 training episodes against 22.4% held out. Recorded as the defect's signature, quoted nowhere as accumulation.
the n=75 screen's -2.7 [-12.0, +6.7] for gen1 vs gen0 — underpowered, NOT filed as §4's one-shot, per a reading note committed before the number existed.
6_BOUNDS_CARRIED: One model, one environment family (v3), one budget (12 actions across up to 3 decisions).
Two synthetic environments sharing one harness whose blind spots would be invisible to both.
gen1's heads were fitted on 2,824 rows against gen0's 4,052 — fewer, so the rise is conservative, but it is not a matched-data comparison.

Consumption is CONSISTENT with the d3-only change and the 48.8% vs 41.5% already-found fractions; it is NOT demonstrated. d2 is identical between generations, so one point of that trend is informative.
gen3 is empty by construction: the loop has three decisions and gen2 moved the last one.
7_REPRODUCTION: experience/reproduce_8b_accumulation.sh — four arms, six pairings, containment checked over BOTH limbs (the rise AND the stop). Nine head md5s and measured signature disjointness gate it; both gates exercised by making them fail.
